title: Ossian's Gift
summary: Ossian writes (badly, in gold ink) that he found his quiet place: a bastion the piglins abandoned. He left something there for the only fair customer he ever had.

goals.say: A pile of gold with a note: 'For the fair one.'

quest_book.title: For the Fair One
quest_book.author: Ossian
pages:
You paid me!

Nobody pays Ossian. They threaten Ossian.

I found a quiet place. Old bastion. I left you something on the top floor. Gold for gold.

- O.
